original.target_description: Study 4 is identified, but the description physical cleansing and guilt does not uniquely establish a test. Study 4 reports both compensatory volunteering and a moral-emotions composite including guilt; no guilt-only test is printed.

replication.target_description: Experiment 4: Spanish Catholic undergraduates recalling an unethical deed; hand cleansing versus no cleansing predicting volunteering to help, Yates chi-square. The separate negative-emotion t test is not combined with this test.

n.sample_role: Participants in volunteering contingency table; 13 non-cleansed, 15 cleansed.
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported; Table 3 contains all 28 participants.
